name: fbla2027
description: Volunteer management platform for nonprofits (FBLA 2026-27 Coding & Programming).

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fbla2027 --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fbla2027 --only auth,firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:tier0: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 E2E_FUNCTIONS_PORT=15001 firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.e2e.json --project demo-fbla2027 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node scripts/seed-demo.mjs --shift-starts-in=10m && playwright test e2e/tier0.spec.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:tier1a: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 E2E_FUNCTIONS_PORT=15001 firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.e2e.json --project demo-fbla2027 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "node scripts/seed-demo.mjs --shift-starts-in=10m && playwright test --workers=1 e2e/tier0.spec.ts e2e/tier1-laneA.spec.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fbla2027 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:functions && npm run check:tokens
